name: batuta
title_zh: 指挥家全套乐谱：技能、角色、脚本一次入袋
tagline_zh: 别再东拼西凑搭工作流。这套 collection 把技能集、角色定义和脚本按指挥逻辑排好，装完即用。
tagline_en: Stop assembling workflows piecemeal. This collection arranges skillsets, roles & scripts with conductor.
desc_en: My Maestri workflow: skillset, roles, scripts
why_zh: 它把分散的 skill、role、script 收编成一套可复用的总谱，版本随 repo 走。
why_en: It consolidates scattered skills, roles & scripts into one reusable score, versioned with the repo—one command restores your.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Maestri 框架下的三类资产；不含 GUI、不含教程、不含跨框架适配。
limit_en: Covers only Maestri-framework assets (skillsets, roles, scripts). No GUI, no tutorial, no cross-framework adaptation. You must read the repo README.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Maestro's full score: skills, roles & scripts in one
